text: The console window is AppKit, made in code: a read-only text view that follows the end and stops following when scrolled up; Find (⌘F, ⌘G), Clear (⌘K) and Close (⌘W) handled by the window itself, with Caps Lock on or off; the app's theme of colours and font, or the library's default, in which a marker never takes an error's or a warning's colour; brought forward as the About window is; and a show-quiet-lines toggle that filters in the view and follows the app's own setting. An example app shows each, CI builds it, and hv checks it by eye.

state.evidence: hv's look by eye in gtools-ic's session, 22 Oct 2026, at the example built from main 607bf4f (0.2.0's code), launched under env -i: the masthead row and its menu (Console..., Run a Command, Rotate the Log), the console window (followed log, quiet lines shown with the toggle, a run framed by the marker and its exit line, warning and error colours, the marker in its own colour), and the About window; hv: LGTM
